p: known: He declares that God's power is evidently seen in preserving his people and destroying his enemies.
Salem also is his tabernacle: Which later was called Jerusalem.
the mountains of prey: He compares the kingdom full of extortion and rapine to the mountains that are full of ravening beasts.
found their hands: God has taken their spirits and strength from them as though their hands were cut off.
sight when once thou art angry: God with a look is able to destroy all the power and activity of the enemies, no matter how many or mighty.
save all the meek of the: To avenge the wrongs done to your Church.
wrath of man shall praise thee: For the end will show that the enemy was able to bring nothing to pass: also you will bridle their rage that they will not accomplish their purpose.
round about him bring presents unto: That is, the Levites who dwell about the Tabernacle, or the people among whom he dwells.
cut off the spirit of princes: The Hebrew word signifies "to vintage or gather grapes" meaning that he will make the counsels and enterprises of the wicked tyrants foolish and vain.
